description: This PHP source file defines a class ListViewSmartyEmails that extends ListViewSmarty, providing specialized functionality for handling email list views in SuiteCRM. It includes constructor setup and a setup method to prepare data for display, including handling parameters such as export, multiSelectPopup, mass update, and filter fields.

classes.name: ListViewSmartyEmails
classes.description: A class extending ListViewSmarty to provide email-specific list view functionality, including setup for export, mass update, filtering, and display processing.
